visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and a black T-shirt stands in a modern, brightly lit kitchen environment. He holds a ceramic bowl containing white rice, seared protein strips, and white sauce. He smiles excitedly at the camera, his eyes wide and mouth open. Behind him, kitchen cabinets and appliances are visible in a clean, contemporary setting. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of a kitchen counter with various food preparation items. We see a bowl of light-tan protein strips, a red milk carton, and small spice containers. The lighting is bright studio-style, highlighting the textures of the ingredients. The man's hands are seen manipulating the objects with precision. (3) The man demonstrates the cooking process by pan-frying protein strips in a black skillet until they reach a golden-brown hue. He uses silver metal chopsticks to flip the pieces. The background kitchen features a tiled wall and a range hood. His facial expressions remain highly animated and focused on the task. (4) He prepares a marinade in a shallow black pan, adding water and various dark-colored liquids from small white bowls. Whole spices like star anise and cinnamon sticks are clearly visible floating in the mixture. He pours red powder from a small green-labeled spice jar with a steady hand movement. (5) After simmering, the protein strips are moved to a wooden cutting board and sliced into small, irregular pieces with a large kitchen knife. The man then uses a handheld blue and black blowtorch to sear the protein on a white rectangular plate, producing visible orange flames and charred edges. (6) In a tall, clear glass container, the man combines white liquid, oils, and seasonings to create homemade vegan mayonnaise. He uses a silver immersion blender with a green button to emulsify the ingredients until they become a thick, white cream. His face shows intense concentration during this technical step. (7) The final assembly involves the man topping a bowl of rice with the charred protein and squeezing white sauce from a clear plastic bottle in a zigzag pattern. He uses the blowtorch again to lightly sear the sauce. Finally, he sprinkles dark green shredded seaweed on top with his fingers. (8) A young woman with glasses and her hair tied in a bun joins the man in the kitchen. Both individuals use chopsticks to eat the prepared food, displaying exaggerated expressions of delight and satisfaction. They stand close together, laughing and talking, while the man briefly hugs her from behind as she continues to eat.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an engaging and high-energy tutorial to teach viewers how to prepare a vegan version of Char Siu rice and homemade vegan mayonnaise. It leverages fast-paced editing and charismatic presentation to demonstrate that vegan cooking can be appetizing, accessible, and fun.
